fee_notes: Base Minimum Initial Franchise Fee is $59,900 for territory up to 300,000 population. Additional territory charged at $200 per 1,000 population. Actual range in 2025 ($47,920-$135,068) reflects available discounts (Roll-In, Multi-Unit, Additional Concept, HIRE, VetFran) and additional territory purchases. Rural franchise special pricing floor: $40,000. Multiple discount programs available with specific combination restrictions.
raw_excerpt: For each, the Home and Business Option and the Auto Option, the initial franchisee fee you must pay to us is $59,900 (the "Minimum Initial Franchise Fee")... In the year ended December 31, 2025, the average initial franchise fee paid by Glass Doctor franchisees was approximately $64,502, and the initial franchise fee paid during that period ranged from $47,920 to $135,068 based on the population in the territory purchased and available discounts.
